title: Dropping Legacy Column After Full Rollout & Soak (Positive Control)

context_files.db_migration_policy.md:
# Engineering Policy: Zero-Downtime Database Migrations
- Rule 2: A `DROP COLUMN` migration must NEVER be executed against production while any active replica/pod is serving traffic with an older application version.
- Rule 3: 100% of serving pods must be running the new version with zero metric reads to the deprecated column for at least 24 hours prior to column deletion.
